subject: Cohort grant concession: ops checklist + limited legal exception request
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@foundersbridge.co>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: legal@foundersbridge.co
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohort grant — ask for one-time concession + billing path

Hi Jonas & Laura,

Thanks again for the pilot run last month — the cohort loved the latency and logging hooks. We have a time-sensitive ask from our finance committee: can Redwood make a one-time concession for the incoming July cohort so we can include a promotional grant on the July invoice schedule? Details below: 

- Requested concession: 60% bonus credits applied to first-month usage (applies to sandbox/starter pack only)
- Reason: cohort demo day commitments; majority of spend will occur week 2–4 and the committee wants predictable sponsor-led credits applied up-front
- Billing ask: credits must appear as a line item on July invoice; our accounting team needs a short deck explaining the concession mechanics for audit (1 pager)

We understand this is an exception. If it helps, legal (CC'd) is willing to accept a short limited-scope addendum instead of a full contract change. Can you confirm operational feasibility and any limitations (e.g., non-transferable, no retro activity)?

Attaching the cohort summary and expected usage window for context.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Partnerships Manager | FoundersBridge Incubator

Attachments: FoundersBridge_Cohort_July2028.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@foundersbridge.co>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort grant — ask for one-time concession + billing path

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and context. Short answer: we can support a one-time credit concession with a limited addendum and a special billing line item, but we need to lock the operational constraints now so Finance and Billing know what to expect. Proposed plan below: 

1) Concession terms (proposed): 60% bonus credits applied to first 30 days of usage, eligible only for the specified cohort IDs (non-transferable), expires 30 days after activation.
2) Billing: Redwood will render a single invoice for July with a line item "Promotional cohort credits (FoundersBridge)" and a negative credit amount equal to the dollar value of the bonus credits. This preserves our rev-rec flow.
3) Legal: we will provide a 1-page addendum that references the existing MSA and specifies the limited exception (no other contract terms changed). I will attach a draft.
4) Ops checklist (high-level): allocation of credit IDs, activation window, tag-based usage filtering, one-time reconciliations with RB billing. I attached a draft concession memo (redwood_concession_draft_20280627.pdf) and the operational playbook snippet (MA-playbook-v2.docx).

Next steps I propose: Laura/Neha — can you confirm operational items 4.1–4.4 below by EOD? I want to get a signed addendum to you by Thursday so finance can close their July runbooks.

Operational items for ops/Billing (please reply with short confirms):
- 4.1: Can billing accept a negative-line credit with a custom memo?
- 4.2: Can Product tag cohort traffic so we only count sandbox/starter pack tokens to the concession?
- 4.3: Do we need a manual reconciliation step post-invoice? (estimate: 1–2 hours of ops time)
- 4.4: Any SLA impacts if we enable the bonus credits early?

If all green, I'll send the addendum and an internal approval note for Ben to sign off on the concession.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head, Startup Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_concession_draft_20280627.pdf, MA-playbook-v2.docx
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@foundersbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort grant — ask for one-time concession + billing path

Jonas / Elena — quick operational notes: 

- 4.1 Billing: we can do a negative-line credit with a custom memo. Billing will need the credit dollar amount by 06/29 COB to include on the July invoice.
- 4.2 Tagging: Product can tag the cohort traffic if FoundersBridge provides the cohort IDs and the sandbox project IDs by EOD 06/28.
- 4.3 Reconciliation: yes, we will run a manual reconciliation post-invoice. I'll allocate 2 hours from Billing Ops and flag any differences > $250 for finance review.
- 4.4 SLA: no change to runtime SLA; this is purely an accounting/crediting construct. If they request credits earlier than activation, we will gate activation to the cohort launch date.

Operational ask for Elena: please send the cohort IDs and preferred dollar value for the bonus credits (or a target % we can compute against estimated usage). Also confirm whether the grant should be visible to the teams (so they see the credit in the console) or hidden (applied only at invoice time).

I'll compile a one-page ops note to attach to the addendum once we have those numbers.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@foundersbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort grant — ask for one-time concession + billing path

Team — I reviewed the proposed concession and accept it under the following guardrails: 

- One-time exception: 60% bonus credits to the specified cohort only; non-transferable; activation window limited to 30 days post-launch.
- Financial cap: Redwood liability capped at $12,500 net value for this concession. If FoundersBridge's requested credit value exceeds this, we will revert to a tiered discount instead.
- Documentation: Legal addendum signed by FoundersBridge and Redwood required before activation.

Jonas — proceed to finalize the addendum and get legal signoff. Laura — once Elena provides cohort IDs and dollar target, confirm billing entry and send the ops note. Neha — please tag this deal FD-BRIDGE-2028-0397 in HubSpot so we have a record for renewals.

Ben Carter
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
